summary: [Square] events: Webhooks v2 (GA): payment.created/updated, order.created/updated, refund.created/updated, terminal.checkout.updated, inventory.count.updated. For OAuth-connected sellers, events fire on the SaaS account endpoint + webhook logs. Scope gaps cause SILENT non-delivery (payment webhooks need PAYMENTS_READ): monitor webhook logs. Polling fallback: SearchOrders (location-partitioned, 1,000/page), ListPayments with cursors.
